items: Every worker runs the same partition function: floorMod(hash, R)
Same key always lands on the same partition, on every mapper
A changed function reshuffles everything: version it with the job
cards.title: Same Function Everywhere

items: Each mapper sorts its own partition slice before writing
Sorted slices merge with one line per file in reducer RAM
Local order is what makes the global merge cheap
cards.title: Local Sort Is the Trick

items: Files are named by mapper and partition: mPrR, checksummed
The file set is the shuffle contract the reducer reads
Checksums turn silent corruption into a detected rerun
cards.title: Files Are the Contract

meta.title: Partition Everywhere the Same, Sort Locally
